name: Machine Learning
shortDescription: Machine learning finds patterns in examples. Learn inputs, labels, simple predictions and fair checks using tiny lists of numbers that you can follow by hand.
highlights: Learn about regression predicts numbers
Learn about compare with a baseline
Learn about group without answer labels

name: Deep Learning
shortDescription: Deep learning uses layers of number calculations. Learn weights, activations, mistakes and small updates with examples you can work out before using a large library.
highlights: Learn about an activation changes the shape
Learn about loss measures a mistake
Learn about batches and epochs

name: Artificial Intelligence
shortDescription: Artificial intelligence includes methods for search, planning and learning. Explore simple choices and checkable rules with classroom examples and clear limits.
highlights: Learn about represent a problem as states
Learn about respect all constraints
Learn about check who the data represents

name: Data Science
shortDescription: Data science uses information to answer questions. Learn to organise, clean and compare small fictional datasets, then explain what the numbers can and cannot tell us.
highlights: Learn about read a tiny csv table
Learn about count categories
Learn about a pattern does not prove a cause

name: NumPy
shortDescription: NumPy stores and calculates with arrays of numbers. Learn shapes, positions, simple calculations and copies using tiny lists you can understand by hand.
highlights: Learn about choose a data type
Learn about broadcast one value
Learn about make an independent copy

name: Pandas
shortDescription: Pandas helps work with data arranged in rows and columns. Learn to select, filter, group and check a small fictional score table with clear Python examples.
highlights: Learn about read by label with loc
Learn about sort rows by a value
Learn about read a tiny csv

name: Matplotlib
shortDescription: Matplotlib draws charts from data. Learn figures, axes, labels and honest chart choices using small fictional examples that you can explain without advanced maths.
highlights: Learn about compare categories with bars
Learn about control visible limits carefully
Learn about explain missing observations

name: Scikit-learn
shortDescription: Scikit-learn provides tools for small machine-learning tasks in Python. Learn features, fitting, predictions and fair checks using tiny data and built-in examples.
highlights: Learn about keep test data separate
Learn about scale using training data
Learn about cross-validation repeats a check

name: TensorFlow
shortDescription: TensorFlow calculates with tensors and trains models. Learn small numeric operations, gradients and a first Keras model while keeping training demonstrations separate from proven results.
highlights: Learn about choose the numeric type
Learn about reshape the same data
Learn about train a tiny model

name: PyTorch
shortDescription: PyTorch works with tensors and neural-network layers. Learn shapes, simple calculations, gradients and training steps using small examples with honest limits.
highlights: Learn about set a dtype
Learn about track a gradient
Learn about one training step

name: OpenCV
shortDescription: OpenCV helps programs work with pictures. Learn image arrays, colour order, crops, resizing and simple filters using tiny synthetic images instead of personal photos.
highlights: Learn about convert bgr to rgb
Learn about threshold brightness
Learn about use a mask to select pixels

name: LangChain
shortDescription: LangChain helps connect steps in language-model applications. Learn its local runnable and prompt tools with small functions, without loading a model or calling a paid service.
highlights: Learn about connect steps with a pipe
Learn about prepare chat messages
Learn about validate an input before continuing

name: Generative AI
shortDescription: Generative AI makes new text, pictures, sound or code from learned patterns. Learn how to describe a task, inspect a result and recognise limits using small worked examples.
highlights: Learn about a toy word chooser
Learn about diffusion starts from noise
Learn about evaluate with a small checklist

name: Large Language Models
shortDescription: Large language models produce text from learned patterns. Learn tokens, context, next-token choices and evidence checks through small examples with clearly stated limits.
highlights: Learn about a vocabulary gives pieces ids
Learn about attention connects text pieces
Learn about check a structured answer

name: Prompt Engineering
shortDescription: Prompt engineering means writing and testing clear requests for AI tools. Practise goals, source text, examples and checks with everyday tasks and honest missing-information answers.
highlights: Learn about give the needed source
Learn about set useful limits
Learn about test easy and tricky cases

name: Hugging Face
shortDescription: Hugging Face provides model and dataset tools. Learn to read model information and use local Datasets and Tokenizers examples without downloading a model or publishing files.
highlights: Learn about make a dataset from a dictionary
Learn about split data for later checks
Learn about pad a sequence and inspect its mask
